Updates the backport of [#31402](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31402) to use the primary output's execution path as the remote file-write request ID. This avoids recomputing action fingerprints solely for tracing metadata when using `--file_write_strategy=remote`.

Validation passed 1,025 remote-cache unit and integration test cases, with two skipped cases and no failures.
